title: Cotton Corporation of India Launches 'Kapas Darshan' Bulletin & ₹5,659 Cr Kapas Kanti Mission
summary: Transfers ₹41,530 crore directly to cotton farmers under record MSP procurement operations.

blocks.content: Transfers ₹41,530 crore directly to cotton farmers under record MSP procurement operations.

items: MSP Procurement: CCI procured 522 lakh quintals of seed cotton (kapas) via 24 lakh transactions, transferring ₹41,530 crore directly to bank accounts.
Kapas Kanti Mission: Cotton Productivity Mission approved with ₹5,659 crore outlay over 5 years.
